name: Velachery & Pallikaranai 2015 Deluge
description: Severe bowl depression flooding from lake breach and marshland backflow, cutting off Velachery Main Road.

name: Adyar River Basin Overflow
description: Massive fluvial surge along Saidapet and Jafferkhanpet submerging Maraimalai Adigal Bridge.

name: Chembarambakkam Reservoir Outflow Surge
description: Excess discharge of over 30,000 cusecs flooding Manapakkam, Ramapuram, and Nandambakkam lowlands.

name: Mudichur-Tambaram Suburban Submergence
description: Headwaters overflow inundating residential layouts in Mudichur and Tambaram West.

name: Cyclone Michaung 2023 Urban Flash Flood
description: Urban flash flooding centered in T. Nagar and Mambalam Canal corridor with severe street waterlogging.
